calculation.description: Distance from the 20-session high normalized by 20-session median true range, conditioned on five-session trend direction and weighted by recent volatility expansion relative to the 60-session baseline. Positive values identify trend-supported proximity to a breakout; negative values identify trend-supported weakness. Uses only completed historical bars.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive across 2020-2022 (+0.054823), 2023-2024 (+0.015691), and 2025-2027 (+0.023562). Cross-section is 15 tradable benchmark instruments; dates meet the >=8 valid instrument rule. The signal is highly correlated with the existing unweighted breakout-distance artifact and should receive conservative incremental ensemble weight.
